mainObjective: The hook and entry to the academy.

plotPoints.title: Room 1: Ma's Watering Hole
plotPoints.description: The party arrives at Ma's Watering Hole, a rural inn between Yatar and Waterdeep. Ma runs the inn and Blarg, a large half-orc, handles security.

plotPoints.title: Room 2: Ruined Cathedral Main Hall
plotPoints.description: The party reaches the ruined cathedral. Thick webs cover the entrance and the main hall is dark and damaged.

plotPoints.title: Room 3: Cathedral Storage
plotPoints.description: The storage room is mostly empty except for old barrels and dried blood. A web-wrapped figure hangs from the ceiling.

plotPoints.title: Room 4: Priest's Lodging
plotPoints.description: An old bed frame, fireplace, and a cellar door are in this room. Faint light shows through the cellar door edges.

plotPoints.title: Room 5: Cellar Hallway
plotPoints.description:
A collapsed branching tunnel leads to a single large door with light leaking through. If the alarm was triggered, enemies prepare an ambush.

**Exits:**
- South: Room 4
- North: Room 6

plotPoints.title: Room 6: Dead End Ritual Chamber
plotPoints.description: A cultist and Red argue about acquiring more experiments for a necromantic ring. They attack when alerted.

plotPoints.title: Room 100: Conclusion
plotPoints.description:
The party returns to Ma's Watering Hole after ending the immediate threat. They receive lodging and reward, but larger cult activity may continue.

**Exits:**
- None

aid_cult.name: Break the Tithe
aid_cult.description: Help Miriam complete counter-ritual to end Pumpkin King's curse
consequences: Cultists scatter to avoid Pumpkin King wrath
Ma flees to warn Pumpkin King
Pumpkin King faction becomes hostile in future modules
aid_cult.cross_module_impact: Pumpkin King NPCs mention 'traitors who broke the circle'

oppose_cult.name: Destroy the Cult
oppose_cult.description: Side with Red to eliminate the cult
consequences: Red rewards party with gold and Pumpkin King favor
Cult survivors establish new cells elsewhere
Ma reveals Pumpkin King loyalty; Blarg reports party as 'proven worthy'
oppose_cult.cross_module_impact: Miriam's ghost haunts later areas; cultists appear as undead

negotiate.name: The Third Path
negotiate.description: Negotiate with druid circle to absorb curse without sacrifice
negotiate.prerequisite: Father Aldric's lore OR druid artifacts from Thornwood
consequences: Druid spirits absorb the curse into the land
Both Miriam and Red leave peacefully
Optional druid ally available in Thornwood
negotiate.cross_module_impact: Druid spirit may assist in Thornwood Watch encounters
